paths.role: download_page: the static, authenticated page (app/static/schwab_download/index.html); redirects an unauthenticated browser to OG-a-3's login

exchange: anti-CSRF, Origin-checked POST body carrying the ticket (never a query/path/redirect/referrer); {"start": false|absent} peeks metadata without consuming, {"start": true} atomically consumes the ticket and streams the CSV

match: exact path; each path is forwarded by the ALB WITHOUT authenticate-oidc, exactly as OG-a-3's two paths are; no wildcard and no other path is implied
route_class_note: Both entries are 'public' in tests/test_principal_cutover.py's ROUTE_CLASS -- the SAME reasoning as OG-a-3's /schwab/download/login and /schwab/download/callback (NFRA_OPLGTW-S14): neither route consults the Authorization bearer scheme or the ALB access-layer header at all, so their answer is invariant to both (the public-route arm at test_principal_cutover.py:551-557 and the else-branch at test_data_entitlement_guard.py:722-729 both grade exactly that invariance). The REAL guard -- OG-a-3's session cookie plus the ticket's own identity/grant/single-use checks -- is enforced independently in app/download_routes.py and app/integrations/schwab/export.py and is exercised by OGX1-AC1..AC16, never by ROUTE_CLASS.
methods_note: Starlette serves HEAD for every GET route, so HEAD is listed as served for the page; the exchange is POST only.
